# description-list API reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/documentation.cjs. Do not edit. -->

Read-only term/value metadata with native description-list semantics.

## DescriptionList

Display read-only metadata for one record as a native description list.
Supply immutable items with stable IDs or compound Item children. Strings remain literal;
formatting, missing-value labels, loading and empty states belong to the consumer.
Auto layout stacks without a named container and shares two columns from 480px of the
nearest apvee-sx ancestor. Explicit horizontal/vertical overrides the query.
Uses Fluent theme variables and the host Griffel renderer, with no SPFx provider requirement.
No generated inline styles, keyboard behavior, cloning or application state.
Empty data/absent children render nothing; empty fragments can leave an empty dl.

### Imports

```ts
import { DescriptionList } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import { DescriptionList } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import { DescriptionList } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/description-list';
```

### Use when

- One record has read-only named values requiring native term/definition semantics.

### Avoid when

- Use DataGrid for tabular collections of records.

### Examples

#### Basic usage

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { DescriptionList } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

<DescriptionList items={[{ id: 'owner', label: 'Owner', value: 'Ada Lovelace' }]} />;
```

#### Use the nearest named size container

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { DescriptionList, container, useSx, width } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
function RecordDetails() {
  const sx = useSx();
  return <section className={sx(container.inlineSize, width.full)}>
    <DescriptionList items={[{ id: 'owner', label: 'Owner', value: 'Ada' }]} />
  </section>;
}
```

#### Compose conditional metadata pairs with inner slot refs

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { Badge } from '@fluentui/react-components';
import { DescriptionList } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
function ConditionalDetails({ showStatus }: { showStatus: boolean }) {
  const valueRef = React.useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null); // React 17's legacy ref initializer.
  return <DescriptionList aria-label="Record details" layout="horizontal">
    <DescriptionList.Item label={{ title: 'Account owner', children: 'Owner' }}>
      {{ ref: valueRef, children: (Component, props) => <Component {...props}><p>Ada Lovelace</p></Component> }}
    </DescriptionList.Item>
    {showStatus && <DescriptionList.Item label="Status"><Badge appearance="filled">Active</Badge></DescriptionList.Item>}
  </DescriptionList>;
}
```

## DescriptionListBaseProps

Shared native dl attributes and pair layout; items and compound children are supplied
by the mutually exclusive public DescriptionListProps branches. Raw HTML is unavailable.

Source-owned support type; no public named import.

### Examples (4)

```ts
import { DescriptionListProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
const layout: DescriptionListProps = { layout: 'vertical', 'aria-label': 'Record details' };
```

### Type

```ts
type DescriptionListBaseProps = Omit<React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<'dl'>, 'children' | 'dangerouslySetInnerHTML'> & {
  /**
   * when omitted, defaults to auto: stacked below 480px of the nearest apvee-sx container, horizontal at/above it.
   * Without that ancestor or CSS container-query support, auto stays stacked.
   * @defaultValue 'auto'
   */
  layout?: DescriptionListLayout;
  /**
   * Unsupported raw-HTML pathway; use items or compound children.
   * Must be omitted or undefined in this branch.
   */
  dangerouslySetInnerHTML?: never;
}
```

### Members (2)

| Member | Type | Requirement | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `DescriptionListBaseProps.dangerouslySetInnerHTML` | `never` | Forbidden | — | Unsupported raw-HTML pathway; use items or compound children.<br>Must be omitted or undefined in this branch. |
| `DescriptionListBaseProps.layout` | `DescriptionListLayout \| undefined` | Optional | 'auto' | when omitted, defaults to auto: stacked below 480px of the nearest apvee-sx container, horizontal at/above it.<br>Without that ancestor or CSS container-query support, auto stays stacked. |

## DescriptionListEntry

Immutable term/value pair for a single record's read-only metadata. The list preserves
input order and uses `id` as a React key; values remain caller-formatted literal content.

### Imports (3)

```ts
import type { DescriptionListEntry } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { DescriptionListEntry } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { DescriptionListEntry } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/description-list';
```

### Examples (5)

```ts
import { DescriptionListEntry } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
const owner: DescriptionListEntry = { id: 'owner', label: 'Owner', value: 'Ada' };
```

### Members (3)

| Member | Type | Requirement | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `DescriptionListEntry.id` | `string \| number` | Required, readonly | — | Stable unique identity within the list; React key, not a generated DOM ID. |
| `DescriptionListEntry.label` | `NonNullable<ContentSlot<"div">>` | Required, readonly | — | Meaningful term: scalar, JSX or Fluent div-slot props/render callback. Boolean conditions<br>are absent; strings stay literal. Only as="div" is supported; raw HTML is unsupported. |
| `DescriptionListEntry.value` | `ContentSlot<"div">` | Required, readonly | — | Associated value inside a native dd. Undefined/boolean leaves it empty; Fluent legacy null<br>remains supported. Explicit props request a div even with empty children. Slot refs target this div. |

## DescriptionListItemProps

One compound pair, requiring DescriptionList and inheriting its layout.
Native attributes/ref target the grouping div, which has no box in horizontal layout.
Content slots remain inside invariant native dt/dd cells; caller JSX keeps its identity.

### Imports (4)

```ts
import type { DescriptionListItemProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { DescriptionListItemProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { DescriptionListItemProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/description-list';
```

### Examples (6)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { DescriptionList } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
<DescriptionList><DescriptionList.Item label="Owner">Ada</DescriptionList.Item></DescriptionList>
```

### Type (2)

```ts
interface DescriptionListItemProps extends Omit<Pick<DetailedHTMLProps<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, HTMLDivElement>, keyof HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> | "key">, "dangerouslySetInnerHTML" | "children">
```

### Members (4)

| Member | Type | Requirement | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `DescriptionListItemProps.children` | `ContentSlot<"div">` | Required | — | Associated value slot. Undefined/boolean/legacy Fluent null leaves an empty dd. Strings/JSX<br>retain their div wrapper; empty props objects request a div. Callbacks receive the fixed div<br>and composed props during rendering, without prior execution to determine presence. |
| `DescriptionListItemProps.dangerouslySetInnerHTML` | `never` | Forbidden | — | Unsupported raw-HTML pathway; use label and children slots.<br>Must be omitted or undefined in this branch. |
| `DescriptionListItemProps.label` | `NonNullable<ContentSlot<"div">>` | Required | — | Meaningful term as scalar, JSX or Fluent div-slot props/render callback; literal strings are not parsed.<br>as may only repeat "div". Consumer attributes/ref target the inner div, never the native dt. |

## DescriptionListProps

Native dl attributes and mutually exclusive data or compound content.
Uses the host's Fluent theme and Griffel renderer, with no SPFx provider requirement.

### Imports (6)

```ts
import type { DescriptionListProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { DescriptionListProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { DescriptionListProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/description-list';
```

### Examples (8)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';

```

### Type (4)

```ts
type DescriptionListProps = DescriptionListBaseProps & (
  | {
      /**
       * Ordered immutable pairs with unique IDs. Empty arrays render nothing.
       */
      items: readonly DescriptionListEntry[];
      /**
       * Unavailable when items supplies the content.
       * Must be omitted or undefined in this branch.
       */
      children?: never;
    }
  | {
      /**
       * Unavailable when compound children supply the content.
       * Must be omitted or undefined in this branch.
       */
      items?: never;
      /**
       * Compound Items, fragments and conditions in declaration order.
       * Absent/boolean children render nothing; an empty fragment may leave an empty dl.
       * When omitted in the compound-content branch, the list renders nothing.
       */
      children?: React.ReactNode;
    }
)
```
